claim: The PR bundles four independent changes: a new List lemma, roughly 320 lines of path-vertex decomposition lemmas in Vertices.lean (plus style edits to its existing proofs), a new strong-connectivity file for quivers, and the matrix irreducibility/primitivity file. The matrix file, which is what the title announces, uses none of the new Vertices.lean lemmas or the List lemma.
requested_change: Split the PR. Drop the List lemma (see the separate finding). Send the Vertices.lean decomposition lemmas as their own PR, with a stated use. Keep this PR to StronglyConnected.lean and Irreducible/Defs.lean, or split those two as well so the quiver API can be reviewed by Combinatorics reviewers separately from the matrix API.
evidence: Irreducible/Defs.lean imports Quiver.Path.StronglyConnected (which imports only Quiver.Path) and the existing Quiver.Path.Decomposition, and never imports Vertices.lean. Its only path lemmas are Path.exists_notMem_mem_hom_path_path_of_notMem_mem (existing, Mathlib/Combinatorics/Quiver/Path/Decomposition.lean:24), eq_of_length_zero and length_cons. List.exists_mem_split is used only by Path.exists_comp_of_mem_vertices in Vertices.lean.

claim: The description is empty, and the title does not match the diff. There is no motivation, no design rationale, no link to the Perron-Frobenius work the title names, and no AI-assistance statement. The title scope 'PerronFrobenius' is not a Mathlib path, and the title leaves out the List and Vertices.lean changes. Several design choices need a stated reason: the development is limited to Matrix n n R over ℝ; the matrix graph is a Quiver rather than Digraph/SimpleGraph; and IsStronglyConnected requires positive-length paths, so a one-vertex quiver with no loop is not strongly connected, while stronglyConnectedSetoid in the same file allows nil paths.
requested_change: Write a description that states the motivation (the downstream Perron-Frobenius development, linked), the design choices above and why they were made, any Zulip discussion, and any dependent or follow-up PRs. Include the AI-assistance disclosure that Mathlib's contribution policy requires. Retitle with a real path scope, e.g. feat(LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Irreducible): ..., and make the title match whatever remains after the split.
evidence: pr.md: 'Description: (no description)'. No Mathlib path contains PerronFrobenius; the only in-library mention is a TODO at Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/GeckConstruction/Semisimple.lean:346 ('may be proved via Perron-Frobenius'), which would make a good motivating link. diff: IsStronglyConnected := ∀ i j, Nonempty {p : Path i j // p.length > 0}, whereas stronglyConnectedSetoid uses Nonempty (Path a b) ∧ Nonempty (Path b a).
